jobs.description: VWorld cadastral parcel editions (연속지적도, MK/30563; root ADR-0148): check the provider's newest edition against the source contract (vworld-parcel-source-objects.json); when it is new, collect its directly downloadable files into Bronze, measure each ZIP's members by ranged read, and propose the contract entry. No Spark: the Silver load runs from a release whose contract holds the edition (runbook vworld-parcel-editions.md). Exit 3 means an edition awaits the contract, not a fault: the job posts 'new edition waiting for contract entry' itself, and is not retried (a retry would only download and propose the same edition again).

expected_outcome.basis: the VWorld parcel edition is released monthly (expected_cadence monthly, 1080 h) plus one daily turn.
